topic: Luffy was born with Conqueror's Haki; Rayleigh only taught control
title: Rayleigh Never Gave Luffy Conqueror's Haki
description: Luffy's Supreme King Haki showed up before he ever trained with Rayleigh. Here's why the Rusukaina lessons were about control, not power. Do you agree?
comment: Was Rayleigh's training what made Luffy a king, or was it always in him? Pick one.

lines.text: Rayleigh didn't give Luffy Conqueror's Haki. Luffy walked in with it.

shot.fallback: straw hat boy with crackling red black aura

lines.text: Here's my read: the training was never about getting it.

shot.fallback: old swordsman training a young pirate on an island

lines.text: Look at what happens before the timeskip.

shot.fallback: straw hat pirate facing a giant bull

lines.text: Luffy's first flash of Supreme King Haki hits Duval's bull, Motobaro.

shot.fallback: giant bull collapsing from a shockwave

lines.text: Then on Amazon Lily, mid-fight with Sandersonia and Marigold, it knocks out most of the Kuja crowd.

shot.search: Luffy Amazon Lily Sandersonia Marigold Haki
shot.fallback: warrior women fainting in an arena

lines.text: And Luffy has no idea he did it.

shot.fallback: straw hat pirate looking confused in an arena

lines.text: People say Rayleigh unlocked it on Rusukaina.

shot.fallback: abandoned island with an old swordsman and a boy

lines.text: But canon says you can't train Conqueror's Haki. You're born with it.

shot.search: Supreme King Haki born with it Luffy
shot.fallback: glowing red black aura around a pirate

lines.text: He showed Luffy all three kinds of Haki by fighting a giant elephant.

shot.fallback: old swordsman facing a giant elephant

lines.text: Then he spent a year and a half drilling the basics into him.

shot.fallback: blindfolded pirate training on an island

lines.text: That's why, after the timeskip, Luffy can knock out only the people he picks.

shot.search: Luffy Haki after timeskip knock out
shot.fallback: pirate with Haki shockwave sparing a crowd

lines.text: So the real gift wasn't power. It was a leash.

shot.fallback: old swordsman with glasses and a steady stare

lines.text: Because Rayleigh didn't give Luffy Conqueror's Haki...

shot.fallback: straw hat boy with crackling red black aura

published.comment: Was Rayleigh's training what made Luffy a king, or was it always in him? Pick one.
